How Many Terms Give 636, Class 10 board exam: how many terms of AP 9, 17, 25 give sum 636? Find n when the sum of the AP 9, 17, 25, … is 636.

• a = 9, d = 8, Sₙ = 636
• Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d], so 636 = n(4n + 5)
• 4n² + 5n − 636 = 0, split: 53n − 48n
• (n − 12)(4n + 53) = 0, so n = 12 (reject −53/4)
